title: Nilave Malare
desc: Raghu struggles to raise his daughter alone after the untimely death of his wife, Janaki. Their life changes, however, after Janaki's lookalike shows up and proposes to raise Raghu's daughter.

title: Bommalattam
desc: A spate of murders during the shooting of a movie shocks everybody. The CBI, who is tasked with investigating the case, suspect Rana, an eccentric film director.

title: Kannedhirey Thondrinal
desc: Vasanth learns that the girl he is in love with is his close friend Shankar's sister. When Shankar shares his bitter past with Vasanth, he decides to sacrifice his love to protect his friendship.
Three men with distinct special needs unexpectedly fall for the same woman, sparking a unique and complicated love story filled with challenges and emotions.

title: Kaakki Sattai
desc: Murali, a young man, wishes to join the police force but his efforts fail. In response to this huge setback, he joins the wrong side of the law.
